Now you can teleport between the save points. （Need talk with You Jinghe to unlock it.)

- Startrack Crystal can be used for retrieving items from warehouse anytime anywhere
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/71fb3ea071042d708245382c507e1e3d8be69f3b.png[/img]

[h1]How to join Alpha Test[/h1]

[h2]Attention: backup your game save before joining Alpha Test[/h2]

This is the most important part, your game save for Alpha Test is shared with stable version, which means if the bugs in Alpha Test damages your game save, you will lose your progress on stable version, too. So we highly recommend to disable Steam Cloud and backup your game save regularly.

Your game save is under Steam\steamapps\common\Immortal Life\SavesDir\"Your SteamID", includes manual_xxxxxx, steam auto cloud(if it exists) and gamedata, etc.


[h2]How to switch between Alpha Test and Stable Version[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Right-click Immortal Life and click "Properties"
[*] Click "Betas" on the left-side bar
[*] Type the code "zhongtian2022" under "Private Betas" 
[*] Click "Check Code" and choose "alpha-alpha test" under Beta Participation(shows "None" by default)
[*] Your game will update automatically and become Immortal Life[alpha]
[*] Want to switch back to stable version? Simply choose "None" under Beta Participation
[/olist]

Please note that all content on Alpha Test may vary without announcement. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: I wish I could stomach Immortal Life's clunky controls long enough to fall in love with a cultivation fantasy farm sim
notes.notes: Farm life sims are one of my favorite genres, but they still don't offer a great variety of settings and themes: They're typically vaguely modern and set on sunny islands or in rural valleys. Immortal Life, a life and farming sim based on the xianxia genre of Chinese fantasy about immortal heroes, offers a refreshingly different "cultivation" spin on the genre—referring not to the farming, but to a genre of fantasy fiction that involves spiritual cultivation. Unfortunately, its extremely clunky controls and dated visuals make it hard to recommend... Read more.

1. New main storyline. The story is now complete. 
2. New Guiyun Journal in the Quest Menu, where you can check the flow chart of the main story, get tips, how to unlock various features of the game. 
3. Improved the storyline about the Friendliness of all your fellow disciples and the corresponding prompts. With each more Heart of Friendliness you get, there will have a related event. After you complete the final event of a fellow disciple, you can invite them to live with you.

You can have everything they get from the exploration quests. 
5. Added Bookmark feature in the Notes. Now you can bookmark items in the Redeem Recipes, Sect Buildings, Crafting, Spell Upgrade pages. You can check the resources you need in Notes anytime.

7. Added Quick Cooking feature. Now you can cook up to 10 same dishes at a time. 
8. A new 3-floor small mystic realm, Guiyun Villa has been added. After the Main Hall is completed and when you reach the middle stage of cultivation, you can complete the Fairy Mirror quest and enter the mystic realm with it, where you can pick tea leaves. 
9. Bonuses have been added to the stone tablet at the Misty Valley Entrance and the Lakeside Pavilion after you complete them. When the stone tablet is completed, you can get 50% more MP when you absorb it. When the pavilion is completed, there is a certain chance that it no longer costs Energy when you use tools. 
10. Settings button in the title screen has been added. You can change graphics, sound and other settings before you start the game. A new set of Cameras has been added. 
11. Added Fish Rubbing Items quests for legendary fish. 
12. Added miniatures of every mystic realm, which can be obtained through Crafting. 
13. Added news skins for your residence. 
14. Added three new places where you can save your game. You can activate them from Sect Building. 
15. Added Steam achievements. 
16. Added new collaboration content with independent game Mountain Gates & Mystic Realms. 

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
1. Optimized the game's saving mechanism. When the game save files are corrupted due to the Internet connection lost when the Steam's cloud saving feature is used, the prompts will be more obvious now. 
2. Good and Superior Watering Gourd are enhanced when charged: Increased the coverage and movement speed of the cloud. However, the duration of the cloud is slightly reduced. When Wind Seeding is used, the seed bag moves faster now. 
3. Optimized the sorting and filtering in the Inventory and Warehouse. Now you can use more functions by right clicking. 
4. Adjusted the watering animation of the Watering Gourd. Now up to 50 of each type of Watering Gourd can be built. 
5. Modified the animation when entertaining fellow disciples. Now you will sit on the seat of honor and dine with them. 
6. Optimized the result at the end of each solar term to avoid all kinds of mechanism failure caused by it; added the animation for the result presentation; Now you will see more clearly the progress of the solar term in the current season when solar terms change. 
7. Alchemy and Cooking screens have been remade; optimized other screens including Course Scheduling, Banquet, Notes, and Sect Building; adjusted the color scheme of all screens. Optimized multi-language display. 
8. Remade the quest related to the Fairy Mirror. Removed the camera switching function of the Fairy Mirror. Now it is the entrance to the Guiyun Villa Mystic Realm. 
9. Remade the quest Divinity Training to make it more interesting. Solved the possibles issues that might be triggered due to the restrictions in the original quest area. 
10. Now there is a small chance to get Pearls from Mussels. 
11. Some numerical optimizations: increased the drop rate of good and superior items; reduced the purchase prices of seeds; adjusted the types or quantity of materials required for some quests; increased the stats points you get from the courses you take. 
12. Adjusted the trigger timing of some side quests. 
13. Optimized the animation performance when you receive paper cranes. Now the paper crane icon shows how many unread paper crane messages you currently have. 
14. Added Sect Elder Costume as the reward when you are promoted to Sect Elder. 
15. Optimized the portals. Now you can go in and out of them in the accelerated state. 
16. Optimized the sound effects for real and fake bait-taking during fishing. Now you can make better judgement. 
17. Optimized the area where monsters appear near the lotus leaf platform in the Yuhua Mystic Realm. Now you will not be attacked earlier than expected. 
18. Optimized the movement of some NPCs. 
19. Optimized the effect of some furniture. 
20. Optimized the textures in some scenes such as Ziyun Peak, Ferry Stop, and Misty Valley. 
21. Now the game loads faster. 

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
1. Fixed an issue that a corrupted save file in a slot will affect the save files in other slots. Save file conflict prompts due to cloud saving or manually copied save files are added. 
2. Fixed an issue that the game may show error messages and crash when a new character is being created. 
3. Fixed an issue that during the banquet quests, the game may show error messages with the debut of a certain character in some specific circumstances. (Even if the issue has been fixed, the game may still show error messages if you have accepted the quest Bridge Repair. So, please try to avoid this quest before and after the update).

5. Fixed several issues about the Shennong Scythe: when the acceleration buff is in effect, harvesting with the Shennong Scythe will no longer miss any crops. Now when the Shennong Scythe is selected, empty-handed interaction is also available. 
6. Fixed the issue that some NPCs can't be displayed on some maps after they have joined the sect or some areas have become available.

notes.title: It’s time for 1.0! Immortal Life Full Release coming up on Jan 18th
notes.notes:
Dear Brothers and Sisters,

We would like to express our gratitude to all of you for your continuous support. In our last announcement, we revealed the full release of Immortal Life, and today we are excited to inform you that Immortal Life 1.0 version will be released during the Laba Festival, Jan 18th, China Standard Time (Jan 17th, Pacific Time)!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/b4371f7e1a0fbf4ece55fd43f186441dd770fea6.png[/img]
It has been a long journey, and we have made significant adjustments to the system, numbering, and UI. We could not have done it without the support of our community. Thank you! 

Since the early access release of Immortal Life, we have received valuable feedback and suggestions from our community. We have worked hard to address them by pushing dozens and dozens of patches, both large and small. We hope that the world of Immortal Life and the Misty Valley will finally become a place where everyone can chill out and have fun.

On this announcement, we would like to take a moment to reflect on the changes we made during the Early Access phase.

[h2]A brand new battle system- [/h2]
Since the early access, we have received many complaints about the original battle system. It was very unrewarding and players kept dying repeatedly in what was supposed to be a chill farming game. To smoothen the experience, we spent months reimagining the battle system and finally, it’s available for everyone to enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/ae2c315676cd22e3221d0bc2e1d7f4633bca1626.png[/img]
[h2]Explorable Mystic Realms- [/h2]
We could only make the Mystic Realms based on the brand-new battle system; with over 10 mystic realms we made in Immortal Life, treasure, powerful bosses, and different exploration mechanics are waiting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/ce09d0d1668eef349ff60072db473fde75ef01bb.png[/img]
[h2]An enjoyable Xiuxian life- [/h2]
Attend classes in the Lecture Hall to cultivate your knowledge, learn powerful spells from Brother Xie (after he finally awakens, that is), discover how to ride your sword and travel between clouds and mountains, or unlock alchemy and craft items with your brothers and sisters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/9fd3c3b91fae2b456572e187187678a824d0dada.png[/img]
There are tons of possibilities for you to explore Xiuxian life. Follow your path to cultivating immortality by succeeding in the breakthroughs on your cultivation level and building great relationships with fellow brothers and sisters.

[h2]Farming like never before- [/h2]
Xiuxian farming is a whole different farming system! You will learn how to use artefacts and spells to help you with your daily tasks. During the Early Access, we focused on improving the farming systems to create a chilling and relaxing experience for everyone. The final version is a lot different than the original idea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/1c40a0e191d44288fbc275b81f2cc333a26ba3ef.png[/img]
[h2]Grow closer to your fellow brothers and sisters- [/h2]
In the beginning, we received feedback that being in the protagonist’s shoes felt like being taken advantage of all the time and used as an errand runner by the other characters. We understood that this was due to the lack of content in early versions and made us realize how important it is to provide feedback from the NPCs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/f156534405e35dc7030fee18d6c873f17e3d34af.png[/img]
To help players feel more connected to the NPCs, we’ve created a lot of content for their personal stories and included daily conversations and Paper Cranes. Our goal is to make every character feel more alive and establish wholesome relationships with the players.

On the 1.0 version of the game, we even included the possibility of inviting one of your brothers or sisters to live with you. The character you select will move into your house and you will help them establish their own room!

Your fellow brothers and sisters are also working towards the mission of rebuilding the Guiyun Sect. You may notice that in the 1.0 version, they are actively participating in this endeavor. You can even ask them to help you explore and collect items from the Mystic Realms in the game now!

[h2]The personalization heaven- [/h2]
Besides the basic gameplay design and the new mechanics, we kept adding more content in the form of decorations, clothes and accessories!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/8f024b4576ccdc24d9404b27083ddf86f9e12574.png[/img]
Now, you can use hundreds of decorations and furniture to decorate your house and farm fields and personalise the looks of the protagonist by choosing and crafting different outfits and unlocking new hairstyles. 

The content we have mentioned above is just a small part of what we have created during the Early Access phase. If you haven't played Immortal Life since the release, we are more than certain that the 1.0 version will surprise you a lot.

Again, we are truly thankful for all the support we have received during the development of Immortal Life and we hope that version 1.0 will give you an exceptional Xiuxian experience.
And if you’re around at the Laba Festival, please come to say hi!

Hello cultivators, are you taking good care of your farms?

Another day starts, your farms look beautiful, your foxes are well-fed and with shiny fur, and another major update is ready for you to download!

You might already know about the content of this update, it’s the same from the alpha branch but translated and integrated into the main branch for everyone to play. Although there’s one difference: we fixed the Steam Deck saving problem. BUT, please be careful, it worked when we tested it but might be different on your devices. Be extra careful when doing it and pay attention to the saving messages, try to save frequently in the beginning and if everything is alright, then go ahead and play normally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/e41dcf9058f3b50eb1416599fbe8f9299bb8e3c4.jpg[/img]

[h2]HOW TO PLAY ON STEAM DECK[/h2]
In order to have the Steam Deck saving files you have to follow these steps:
1*. This step needs to be followed just if your main saves are on the Steam Deck, not on any computer. Make a copy of your save files before uninstalling the game. If you don’t know where it’s stored, follow these steps:
> Switch your Deck to Desktop Mode.
> Open Steam, go to your library and search for Immortal Life.
> On the main Library menu that appears on the left side of the screen, do right-click (L2) > Manage > Browse local files.
> Copy the folder “SavesDir” and copy it somewhere safe. You’ll need to repeat this process after reinstalling the game to place the “SavesDir” you just copied on the new folder after the reinstallation process.
2. Delete the game from your Steam Deck and install it again.
3. Before opening the game make sure that the saves on your Deck are synchronized with the Steam Cloud. You can do it on Properties > General > Steam Cloud > Keep game saves in the Steam Cloud for Immortal Life.
4. Play normally and test if the saving is working on your device!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/10565170574f5067473946a8641645772e21e964.gif[/img]

notes.title: How to fix saving on the Steam Deck - guide
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/801ed32e35a52bf28373b0b85585c7f1e0ce323f.png[/img]

Hello cultivators!

We’re making this guide to help you fix the saving problem on the Steam Deck. These steps were discovered by RosefortheHunter, thanks a lot. We’re putting all the info together with screenshots just to make it easier for you while we continue working to officially fix the problem!

Keep in mind that this solution won’t allow you to crossplay from the Steam Deck to the Computer. In order for this to work you have to disable the saves on the Steam Cloud, and that you won’t be able to change the game to English on the Steam settings, you’ll have to change the language inside the game, so we encourage you to play the game for the first time on the computer to understand the story.
We’re sorry for the inconvenience, we're working on fixing the problem but it is more difficult than we expected.

[h2]Step 1 - Install Proton GE on the Steam Deck[/h2]

This is the longest step, but it’s easy!
First of all, switch your Deck to Desktop Mode. You can do it by pressing the Steam button > select Power > Switch to Desktop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/28202e6b1646ff9f9f8098f87eeb1cc7feb816c4.jpg[/img]
[step1.1]

From your Desktop, select the Discover app store (the blue shopping bag icon on the taskbar marked with “1” on the screenshot). Search for ProtonUp-Qt and click Install once you find it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/21c80d14033f8a9c00294044df4db64cdb300a43.png[/img]
[step1.2]

When ProtonUp-Qt is installed, launch it. You can do it from the same screen as you installed it or searching for Proton on the Installed tab of Discovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/bdd2d074050c00e7380081f89d060e91c84806cd.png[/img]
[step1.3]

When launched, it will pop up a new window. Select Add version, search for 7.Orc6-GE-1 (this is the version you’ll need for Immortal Life), and press Install. Please, be sure you’re installing the “7.Orc6-GE-1” version of Proton-GE since it’s the only one that solves the problem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/3dfeac836d9e0bc95eff3f3da4076d0c742a56b6.png[/img]
[step1.4.1]

Yaii! With Proton-GE installed is time to go back to Steam and make some changes on the Properties of Immortal Life.
 
[h2]Step 2 - Open Steam and go to Immortal Life on your library.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/62d50853b06b5bfed0d13be8f5205c51d930b1db.png[/img]
[step2.1]
Go to Immortal Life on your Steam library and press the wheel for accessing the game settings.
The next steps are all inside of the same menu:

[olist]
[*] Select Developer and click Delete Proton files. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/783ea1a4f94382679451cbd65a46e3a8cc76ba05.jpg[/img]
[step 3.2]
[*] Select Properties > General > untick “Keep game saves in Steam Cloud for Immortal Life” 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/64f595f2af3d64fc1cd3ff7e0eae776d1d2fca48.png[/img]
[step 4.1]
[*] Select PRoperties > Compatability > Tick “Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool” and select “Proton-7.Orc-GE-1” 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/bf6c027730bb54f2b9266ecbb802ec83e2c55cc7.jpg[/img]
[step 5]
[/olist]

Now you’re ready to play on your Steam Deck and save the game correctly. But remember that this won’t allow you to save your files on the cloud.

[h2]Step 3 - Changing the language in the game[/h2]

For first time players - and everyone
You’ll have to start playing the game in Chinese, and when you gain control of your character for the first time you’ll change the language and restart the game. You’ll just have to replay a very small part of the game.

[olist]
[*] Start a new game
[*] Choose your saving slot and continue
[*] Choose a character and write a name and continue (it really doesn’t matter what you write here since we’ll change it later).

Now there will be some text (a letter you receive) and a cutscene). After that a character will talk to us, just advance on the dialogue until you gain control over your character. Now, press the hamburger button of your Steam Deck (the one with 3 lines) to open the menu.

[*] You’re on the settings menu
[*] Click the drop-down and choose English
[*] Press Restart the game.

[/olist]

After doing this, you’ll be on the main title screen again, but the game will be in English. Yaii! Now you can start it again and pick a good name for your character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/17194743ee88b174237311292583e3b9c20506ea.png[/img]
[last-step]


If you have any problem following these instructions or any other related with the game, ask us and we’ll try to assist you.
You can always contact us through Twitter or ask questions on the Discord server where us or other players can answer you!

Twitter - https://twitter.com/2Pcom 
Discord - https://discord.gg/cRQ4U4qwNz 


Thanks for all your patience and continue enjoying the game
2P Games Team

Hello cultivators!!

It’s been three weeks since we updated the new alpha branch for Chinese speakers and now, thanks to the efforts of many people, we’re ready to release the content with all the improvements for everyone!

In this patch, we translated all the new content from the Alpha branch 0.8.03 to English and Japanese. Yaiii!

This is what you’ll find in the new version:

[h2]New Content[/h2]

[list]
[*] Main Quest Extended. Continue with the rebuilding process of the Guiyun Sect under the guidance of Brother Xie.
[*] Added new trade routes with Canghai City, Lingxi Island, Yaowang Palace, and Fullmoon Pass.
[*] Added 2 new mystic realms, Canghai Mystic Realm and Mingyue Mystic Realm. New monsters, recipes, fishing spots and collectables are waiting for you!
[*] Added two new types of rare spiritual plants.
[*] Added the new skill The Five Virtues: When placed in the blessed land array while growing rare spiritual plants, it will increase the yield of the surrounding crops that are currently in season and the elemental energy output of all the surrounding spiritual plants.
[*] Added a new clothing tab. Use it for changing your outfit and easily browsing all your clothing items.
[*] Added a new completed quests tab where you can check out the accomplished quests.
[*] Now you can forge the fishing pole into Epic Level. Using this epic equipment will allow you to catch legendary fish! But watch out, those legendary fish are hard to deal with… You have to focus on the QTE!
[*] Added new fish specimens that can be caught by using the normal fishing pole.
[*] New refinement recipes, including Space Ring and Blessed Farming Tool.
[*] Added a new tool for the Warehouse.
[*] Added new Elixirs recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/988c09297e70579a5079cb97aec3d7805217e3a4.gif[/img]

[*] Now you can move the Warehouse even if there're items inside of it.
[*] Now time will run at a normal speed when you're working on the breakthrough.
[*] Optimised the code of the Wandering Vendor to prevent the case when there is no available Water Orbs to buy from her if you haven't caught much fish yet.
[*] Optimised the Save Loading feature, which allows you to choose the character first, then choose which Save you want to load.
[*] Optimised game logic on production tools and cooking to obtain high-quality items. When all input materials reach a certain star level, the output product will be of the same level or higher (Non-star items are not counted).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/d3b02cb50a38e2515a42898cbbd0821a5e796e45.gif[/img]

[*] Added new art design for Zuo Li and Lin Wanxi for the Banquet Table system.
[*] Added a few lamps around the Main Hall to light up the place at night.
[*] Adjusted the icon of Chrysanthemum Tea.
[*] Adjusted the model of Soulslayer Flying Whale, the Boos of Oceanic Mystic Realm.
[*] Adjusted the model of Anju Lane.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/988c09297e70579a5079cb97aec3d7805217e3a4.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Road to the Foundation - Alpha Branch Update V0.7.03
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/6fea11ab89ff3b8885318fb1ecd7a016f66d23ba.png[/img]

Morning everyone, fellow cultivators! We’re glad to be here once again to share the latest news on the development of Immortal Life. As discussed in the eighth volume of the Sunset Inn Messageboard, all changes happening during the rest of the year will be only available in the Alpha branch of the game. It means that everyone will be able to test an early version of new features, missions, and locations at the same time YiFang Studios uses everybody’s feedback to solve issues.

In addition to this reminder, we must warn you that English and Japanese support will be added at a later date. This decision has to do with the convenience of waiting for the patch to be ready before starting such delicate work as the translation of the game. Please bear all this in mind before going deep into this new update.

That said, it’s time to explore the new content available in the Alpha branch later this week, as well as some new optimization changes made to improve the game experience and your immersion in the world of Immortal Life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/fb54b151921350f16355cd1a35360fbd26215af1.gif[/img]

[u][i]❊Translation in development. The English and Japanese versions of certain missions and elements of the game will be added before the content is available in the main version of the game.
[/i][/u]

[h2]New content[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Main quest extended: Brother Xie has a rebuilding plan to regain the past glory of the Guiyun Sect. Will it be as effective as he promises? Help him find out!
[*] New area: Lianyun Peak.
[*] New map: Spiritual Cave.
[*] Ride your sword to explore some special areas located at the Flower Mystic Realm and the Hot Sand Mystic Realm.
[*] New sect facility: Training Ground.
[*] New characters ready for recruitment: Zuo Li and Lin Wanxi.
[*] New personal stories for Yang Ziqin and Ji Yaohua.
[*] The Foundation Early Stage is now ready for cultivators to breakthrough!
[*] Brother Xie will teach you some spells with the new Skill Training System after the Training Ground has been rebuilt — you will notice that some of them change when reaching a certain power level!
[*] The Alchemy System and the Artifact System will be available to unlock from the Lianyun Peak.
[*] Unlock the Rare Plants System by getting seeds from the new Hot Sand Mystic Realm.
[*] Unlock a new trade road, the Hot Sand Ridge, after defeating the boss of the Hot Sand Mystic Realm.
[*] New furniture sets: Misty Rain Set, Heroine Set, Mechanism Set, Wish Set, Graceful Set.
[*] The new sect level, Thriving With Each Passing Day, will let you unlock the new trade routes to Yishan Town and Mechanism Town.
[*] Get 3 new plants from Yishan Town.
[*] Unlock 9 new cooking recipes to delight the sect members!
[*] You will notice there are new monsters for all mystic realms.
[*] 3 new Lucky Fish specimens are ready to redeem.
[*] You can now visit Mu Xia, Wei Hong, You Jinhe and Song Yantong’s rooms at the sect headquarters.
[*] Left side field of Mystic Valley now open for farming.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/f1577828c535847db20b106005254dcc5f06f8e9.png[/img]

[h2]Optimization changes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Misty Valley’s Mine has been redesigned.
[*] We reduced the amount of information displayed on the map and made some adjustments to the icons and the colors we use.
[*] Pricing has been adjusted for some items.
[*] The drop rate has been adjusted too.
[*] The cultivator skills and the damage caused by monsters have been rebalanced.
[*] NPC daily routine adjusted.
[*] We removed the General or Outdoor limitations for some decorative items.
[*] Now you can customize the color of the Seeds bag.
[*] Characters’ last and first names will be now separated by a space.
[/olist]

[h2]Bugs fixed[/h2]
Fixed a bug that caused the damage dealt to enemies when using Divine Perception to be different from the number defined in the skill description.

[h2]HOW TO JOIN THE ALPHA BRANCH OF IMMORTAL LIFE [/h2]

[h3]Step 1: For your safety, start backing up your save files! [/h3]

This is the most important step as the files of the Alpha branch that will be saved in your Cloud storage will replace those you saved locally, damaging them permanently in the process. To prevent this, disable the Cloud Saving feature and visit the following path to copy the folder with your local saves to another safe location in your computer. Don’t switch to the Alpha test before taking this step. 

Save Path: [Steam Library Path]/common/一方灵田/SavesDir/[A folder with numbers in its name] 

[h3]Step 2: Switch the branch from your Steam library [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/b295974cd6008e78e29206d5ba2aa916cbe14310.png[/img]

[olist]
[*] Right-click Immortal Life in your Steam Library. 
[*] Choose Properties… 
[*] Choose BETAS tab in the Properties menu. 
[*] Enter the code, zhongtian2022 and click Check Code. 
[*] Click the select button and choose alpha – alpha test to activate the new branch. 
[*] You want to switch back? No problem, click the drop-down menu again and choose none – it will take you back to the Default branch. 
[/olist]

And that’s all for today, dear cultivators. If you think there’s any feature, substory or recipe that should be included in the next version of the game, let us know and we will take it into consideration. Also, remember that we love seeing how much you enjoy testing the new content, so please share all your screenshots with us! We love to show people how creative you guys can be. 

Have a great day,
YiFang & 2PGames

notes.title: Sunset Inn Messageboard Vol.8
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/87ed98de0ea8b8bb3ad68de54983144aa0799c27.png[/img]

Dear brothers and sisters,

It's been a while since the latest Sunset Inn Message board post, so we thought this might be the best moment to update you on the status of the major update we've been applying on Immortal Life's battle system — as well as many other topics of your interests as soul cultivators and dwellers of the Misty Valley.
As usual, we'd like to start with an appreciation message to our community for their continued support of our team and 2P Games’. All the things we achieved over the Early Access stage have been possible thanks to your valuable feedback and your enthusiasm for Immortal Life, so thank you very much for choosing us once more. We can't wait to bring more content for you to have fun in its magic world!

[h2]Road to the Foundation stage: what’s happening now?[/h2]

We've spent the past few weeks optimizing the game's code and extending the current features with new content like the Foundation stage. It was first mentioned in the past Sunset Inn Message board and our Community Q&A. This cultivation phase is very important for us since we'd like to design new features around this specific stage and create a strong connection between them. That's why we took so long to make it perfect.

To ensure this content will have the highest quality, all the updates developed in the next two months will be released exclusively in our Alpha branch. As your opinion is very important for us to create a great game, we're sincerely looking forward to learning what you think about this.

If you're interested in joining the test branch, please read these instructions first before taking any action. We know it’s the longest development and testing period we’ve ever had in the history of the game, so we apologize for the inconvenience to the players who want to enjoy new adventures in a stable gaming environment. Please stay tuned for further details!

[h2]New content coming to the Alpha version (date TBD)[/h2]

[b]1. Main Story Extended[/b]
In this chapter, you will help Brother Xie regain the past glory of the Guiyun Sect under his unique Rebuilding Plan.

[b]2. New Building: Sect Apartments[/b]
Xie and Yang have lived at the Sunset Inn since that volcanic explosion wiped out the Guiyun sect headquarters. Now the rebuilding plan is ongoing, they're decided to ask Brother You for new apartments.

[b]3. New Mystery Realm 1: Flower Valley[/b]
A new quest line would lead you to explore the Flower Valley Mystery Realm, it’s full of new monsters, recipes, fishing spots, and collectible items to discover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/ce005372f9a523bbede17277203130bc443b82d1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/2496a740772defb123f6e628557b74237546fbec.png[/img]

[b]4. New Mystery Realm 2: Heat Desert(Temporary Name)[/b]

[b]5. New Recruitable Members: Zuo Li and Lin Wanxi[/b]
The further we go in the reconstruction of the Guiyun headquarters, the more hands we will need! It’s about time to open applications again, and this time there are two good candidates to join the sect — Zuo Li, son of Elder Zuo, a talented alchemist, and Lin Wanxi, the girl who masters artifact crafting. Both candidates are super talented... So, what will you do?

[b]6. Alchemy System[/b]
After rebuilding the Lianyun peak, it’s time let Zuo Li teach you some lessons on how Alchemy works.

[b]7. Artifact System[/b]
The Monsters are getting stronger, especially the ones who live in the Deep. How about asking Lin Wanxi for a little help to defeat them with her powerful artifacts? Of course, Lin would also help your Farm Tools get to a higher level!

[b]8. It’s time to grow some Fruit![/b]
Maybe you need to extend your farm? Now it’s fruit time! We designed a brand new place for you, please stay tuned to our future announcement!

[b]9. New Monsters, Collectible items, and Fish![/b]

[b]10. New Personal Story: JI Yaohua[/b]
Do you wonder how Ji’s business at the Qiongzhen Pavilion has become so successful in no time? Find out about the best-kept secret of their success by talking with her and becoming friends. 

[b]11. New Personal Story: Yang Ziqin[/b]
Talking about who loves Guiyun Sect, there’s just no one could compare with Yang. With a better relationship with him, you shall know why he loves Guiyun Sect so much, and what would this whole rebuilding thing means to him.

[b]12. New Scene: Ji and Li’s house, Mu Xia’s room, Wei and You’s house, Song’s house[/b]
After finishing the in-house design, we think it’s time to let you guys see what their room/house looks like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/2784b3fc3056c1f52de28bd142889fc4c6eecc07.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/16b0cabea0f96a82584a952ff65a46e2ee349763.jpg[/img]

[b]13. Mine Renovation[/b]
With the remake of the Mine map, it’s now easier for you to explore and have funnier battles. 

[b]14. Eastside Stone bridge of Ferry Stop[/b]
The Stone Bridge at the East side of the Ferry Stop is now fixed, you could now visit Mystery Realm through the bridge

[b]15. Spell Training System[/b]
Brother Xie isn’t satisfied with your current way of casting spells, so he decided to train you in gratitude for what you have done for your brothers and sisters.

[b]16. New sect facility: Training Ground[/b]
Here’s where you’ll train your spell-casting skills with brother Xie!

[b]17. Lianyun Peak[/b]
After your character reaches Foundation, You shall use your new skill to ride your sword to reach the Peak!

And that’s all for today, brothers and sisters! We hope it’s enough content to satisfy your eagerness for fun, new adventures, and emotional stories in the world of Immortal Life. And this is just a little part of what we originally planned, so... well, take it easy and focus on the great experiences you’ll live along the journey!

As winter approaches, remember to unpack the long-sleeved in your wardrobe clothes to warm up during cold nights. Hot tea also helps, and it’s super delicious!

Have a great week,
YiFang Studios & 2P Games

notes.title: Sunset Inn Messageboard Vol.6
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/a6dde4849ae4246b80af2151aa6eb37cbaa62274.png[/img]


Greetings, cultivators:
We’re back to welcome August! It's been a month since the last update of the Sunset Inn message board and it's about time to turn the tables, don't you think? Mostly because you'll be eager to know what kind of content is coming to Immortal Life this month.
First of all, we must admit that adjusting the battle system is coming with a great number of difficulties we never imagined. Even though you'll notice huge changes in our current Alpha testing version, there’s still a lot of work to be done to bring it up to the level of other features of the game. In the upcoming months, we'll keep introducing better battle sounds and visual effects, developing an enhanced enemy AI, and planning how to relocate monsters all over the map. In other words, we haven't forgotten our promise! We just need a little more time to create a combat system that feels natural, fun and, of course, full of magic.

[h2] Mission updates for July[/h2]
With all that said, here’s a short summary of the new features, content and gameplay enhancements we worked on last month. They’re now part of Alpha branch to be tested before reaching the main game:
[olist]
[*] Overhauling the battle system:
1.	There’s no need to draw and sheath the word to activate/finish the combat anymore.
2.	Now you can attack or cast a spell while moving, jumping, climbing or collecting items. No need to sheath your sword!
3.	WASD keys can be used for moving.
4.	From this version of the game, you’ll decide the direction of our normal attacks and spell casts with your mouse.
5.	Use Left Click for a normal attack and Right Click for casting spells — we even have created a spell menu for choosing which one to use.
6.	[Temporary] MP consumption per spell will be reduced as a part of a temporary design we will change this very month. In the meantime, you’ll also find there’s no spell cooldown.

[*] New building: Clan Kitchen
In our current Alpha version, you can invite Mu Xia to join the Guiyun Sect and rebuild the Clan Kitchen. It’s way bigger than Sunset Inn’s kitchen, with new cookware (Deep-Frying Wok, Pot...), recipes and, of course, challenging mini-games to put your cooking skills to test!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/66a16cf220ce94828e060a41562605c514af0e92.png[/img]

[*] New solar term mission: Help the Clan Kitchen for each solar term
After you unlock the Clan Kitchen, y this special mission will appear every solar term. It will allow you to earn new rewards and increase your friendship level with the cult members. Don't worry about the ingredients, they're all provided by the sect.

[*] New map: Deep in the Mine
The map's almost finished, except for a few details we need to adjust for a better experience. Soon we'll give you an official update on the status of this area.

[*] New map: Mystery Valley Lake Island
After fixing the Lake Pier, you'll be able to visit the Mystery Valley Lake Island from the docks. Guess what: on that island, you can invite your fellow Sect Members to enjoy the dishes you made!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/d23337e56ea037d1336e15950414a017c86ea713.jpg[/img]

[*] New Feature: Banquet table
On Misty Valley Lake Island, you can invite your fellow Sect Member to enjoy your dishes at the Banquet Table! Everyone has their own taste, so they would give you unique reviews on different dishes. A good score could help you unlock gifts!

[*] House renovation
Starting now, You Jinghe will help you with the house renovation after rebuilding the Main Hall. That means you can get new Floor, Wall, Stair, and Corridor recipes from him!

[*] More character stories
We started working on personal stories for the secondary characters you like the most. These sub-stories will help you improve your relationship with them and learn new interesting information about their pasts after reaching certain Friendliness requirements. We’ve just introduced the personal story of Mu Xia in our Alpha branch. Stay tuned for future updates!

[*] Making Spirit Orbs
We’re now allowing everyone to make a new decorating furniture, the Spirit Orb. 
[/olist]

Plus, we’ve worked on the following changes:
[list]
[*] Adjustments on the Mine
We’re rebuilding the Mine to suit our new battle system, which includes a redesign of certain levels and a relocation of its monsters and collectible items.

[*] Adjustment on the Yuhua Mystery Realm 
As the combat system also influenced the design of the Mystic Realm of Yuhua, we are including some changes to the map and the location of enemies and collectibles — we hope you like it!

[*] Redesign the Spell System
Redesigning the battle system also means that we had a job to do on the Spell system. It evolved so much that you can easily identify the changes. This rebuild is way bigger than what it looks like on the surface, we also changed some parts of its code and redesign the structure deep down in our game build foundation. But the good news is, this would give us more space for introducing new features on the Spell System, please stay tuned.

[*] Monster AI redesign
Same reasons as the others, yes, the battle system redesign also requires us to do changes on the Monster AI, and we did that, period.
[/list]

[h2]Content developed for August[/h2]
[list]
[*] New realm: Flower Valley
We know that adventure lovers hate to sit still for too long, so here's good news: the Flower Valley is open to visitors! You will have to complete a specific mission to unlock this new location, in which you'll find new monsters and fishing spots, more collectible items and, of course, new recipes.
[*] New personal story: Chen Yuanzhou
We've heard you loud and clear, dear cultivators. Some of you have fallen in love with our favourite fisherman and need to find out more about him, so with this new mission you are going to discover his story. We can hear your heartbeat from here!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/8e06e5023758b810668a6b6ca909d35a1de1410d.png[/img]

There are some other elements of the game we’ll start working on this very month. However, the development team might need extra time to polish them depending on how things go with the redesign of the battle system.
[olist]
[*] New events in the main questline
[*] Becoming friends with Xie Wentian
[*] New sect facility: Garrison
[*] New sect facility: Training Ground
[*] New system: Spell Updates System
[*] Personal story: Ji Yaohua
[/olist]

We'll share new photos and videos as soon as these designs look more like their final versions. If you have any suggestions for us to improve the game, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts in the comments below or join our Discord Server to share your ideas! We'd definitely give it a chance after a proper discussion inside our team. After all, everything in Immortal Life is subject to change, please wait for future announcements for disclosing the details.
 
Thank you for your support, wish you enjoy your time in the Misty Valley and find your way to become immortal. 
 
YiFang Studio & 2P Games

notes.title: Sunset Inn Messageboard Vol.5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/1fd4aaf751d16a0966384ed498bdb150af45773c.png[/img]

And finally, July came into our lives! It still surprises us how fast time goes by when working on a project we love, but despite that, we’re happy to see the team has reached the goal set up in our previous roadmap. Some of the features are still being tested in the Alpha branch of the game, but rest assured they will arrive in the main game for all players very soon — we’ll make a short reminder at the end of the entry. With all that said, this is the perfect moment to let you know more of what’s coming to Immortal Life this very month.

[h2]Redesign of the battle system[/h2]

After starting a deep technical research thanks to your feedback, we decided to modify the whole battle system in July. The new system will feature the following changes:

[list]
[*] Currently, if you want to attack an enemy you first have to draw the sword to enter the battle mode. We’re cancelling this design, more info on the new one will be coming soon.
[*] The limitation of movement and stagger of the Basic attack and the Basic spell will be removed.
[*] You will point with your mouse where the basic attacks should be directed.
[*] The Basic Attack will receive several adjustments.
[*] Casting spells and switching between them will be way easier now.
[*] We’ll allow players to jump and interact with other objects in the middle of a battle.
[*] The visual and sound effects you see and hear when attacking a monster or being attacked by one have been adjusted.
[/list]

[h2]What's that delicious smell coming from the Guiyun Sect headquarters?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/66a16cf220ce94828e060a41562605c514af0e92.png[/img]

After Mu Xia joins your clan, you will unlock the new kitchen of the Guiyun Sect and lots of new cookware and amazing recipes to delight your brothers and sisters. Also, there will be special cooking quests in every solar term that will help you increase your friendship level with your fellow sect members — but most importantly, the cooking materials will be free!

[h2]New map area![/h2]

Why did the cultivators cross the river? Easy: to unveil the secrets waiting for them in the other side! You’ll be finally able to rebuild the Ferry stop after the disaster in the mountain. This will allow you to build a new fishing spot and the Opera stage, plus lots of new locations, objects and stories that will entertain you for hours:
[list]
[*] New map: East side of the Ferry stop
[*] New map: Deep in the Mine.
[*] New map: Misty Valley Lake Island.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/6fe8bef678f088827fb76c943d782c7129e1d639.png[/img]
[*] You will be able to change the style of wallpaper, floors, stairs, and the corridor!
[*] Characters stories will be extended with special friendship level events.
[*] New furniture: Monster Ora to expose all creatures you’ve found so far.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/219288496607485f6b30291bc86c94ec07c53ad6.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]More content planned[/h2]

[h3]About the Foundation Stage[/h3]

We’ve kept you waiting so long for the next stage of the Cultivator level “Foundation Establishment”, but fortunately the day has come to share some insights into how we would treat this new Cultivator level.

Removing the limit that blocks the increase of your status max would be the easiest thing to do, but that would make no difference between the current level with the next one. To make it feel somehow special, players would need make some preparations for completing the main quest that unlocks the Foundation Establishment. After that, you'd enjoy some new premium features.
We'll provide you with solid reporting the next time we talk to you about this issue, as at the moment we only have these ideas of what it could look like and we are still refining them. Please stay tuned!

[h3]About Brother Xie[/h3]

We know you’re all expecting to know what happens to Brother Xie after the latest events of Immortal Life’s main mission. Since we’ve been concentrating our energies in improving the combat system and designing the new Cultivator level, the new chapter of his story won’t arrive this month. We’ll start working on it once we're sure you feel happy with the new look of the first feature, because that’s a promise we made to you at the very start of this Early Access phase.

[h2]A short summary on June’s new content[/h2]

Now available on the main branch of Immortal Life:
[list]
[*] Stories of Li Mengqing.
[*] New map: the Yuhua Mystery Realm with new monsters, items, and types of fish.
[*] New plants and flowers all over the Misty Valley.
[*] Turtle Mill.
[/list]

[h3]Now in the alpha version, coming soon to the main branch:[/h3]

[b]1.	Stories of Song Yantong[/b]
Song Yantong has a long quest line that started at the beginning of the game, we hope you enjoy the time spending with her :)

[b]2.	Bee raising[/b]
You can now start raising bees and flowers for making honey! More dishes and features based on honey will be added to our game in the future.

[b]3.	Silkworm raising[/b]
Take care of silkworms to get Silk from them and make some new clothes!

[b]4.	Pet system[/b]
In this first version of the Pet System you’ll be able to adopt a little fox. If you take care of this little guy and let it evolve, the foxy will unlock new abilities to help you out! Of course, there are more Pets coming to Immortal Life in our next updates... but we’ll keep the list secret a little longer ^^

[b]5.	Bugs fixed[/b]
We also fixed some bugs you recently reported on Steam, Discord and social media, and added new icons. Also, you can now adjust the volume of music and the sound effects of Yuhua Mystery Realm.

[b]6.	Major update on English localization[/b]
Thanks to your help, we can bring a better version of the English localization to you patch after patch. We believe these changes are making our game much easier to understand, so please don’t stop helping us in this regard! We really appreciate your contributions.

So, in conclusion, only the optimization of the map UI optimization couldn’t be finished in time. For transparency, we have to say we haven’t found the right person to help with the UI design yet, but we would start working on that once we find the right one. (And we won’t only change the UI of Map)
Besides, Yuhua Mystery Realm wasn’t included in our original plan for May and June, but we figured it out and add it to our game. Even though we do have some bugs in this map currently, we do find our community love how Mystery Realm could bring to our game, thank you all! We would make more Mystery Realm maps in the future.

Thanks for supporting our project with your love and constructive comments, we owe you a lot! 

See you next time,
2P Games & Yifang Studio

notes.title: Sunset Inn Messageboard Vol.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/25a2b2c2fc167cf9669492b40b7aab4b4eb0e842.png[/img]

Hello there, brothers and sisters:

It’s been half a month since our last Messageboard update, so it should be the perfect time for us to share some updates we’ve been working on and how these changes would look like in the game. Let’s take a look at them!

[h2]MOST RELEVANT CHANGES COMING TO IMMORTAL LIFE[/h2]

[olist]
[*]	Custom key binding
You can customize some of the key bindings in the Settings menu soon. 

[*]	Auto watering system
We already introduced the Modified Irriwell with a larger water range in our previous update, but we know it’s not enough to cover your all needs. In the current developing version, we’re creating a brand-new watering system that works automatically 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. And the best part is, it doesn’t consume your MP — thank Wei Hong later!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/3754507a809b85ef450ab89f6e356983fe015823.png[/img]
We also adjust the size of the watering equipment so they won’t block your sight for checking the field.


[*]	Premium Stone Mill and Fermentation Jar
We are working on enhanced versions of both items. The creation of the jar is still in progress, but we will soon give you more information on how it works. The new Stone Mill is powered (or, we should say... powdered? *ba dum tss*) by a spiritual tortoise that frees you from using it by hand. Also, it introduces an option to adjust how many products you need each round.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/5452b10234d3c425f89a237029dc72c8c30937d3.png[/img]

[*]	New food processing equipment
The Air-Drying Rack is almost ready for you, with a premium version and new cooking recipes on the way.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/33e736f664a7d37b7826aadde75ad3868c5e9983.png[/img]

[*]	New way of harvesting crops
Originally, this spell was represented by the bag of seeds you can see in the image below. However, we stopped its development to give it a twist because we think it should be more visually appealing. Stick around if you want to know more!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/8dcade828b14246f9b186f3838166d5f23ff7461.gif[/img]

[*]	Pet system
These cute buddies will help you a lot in your daily tasks and, of course, you also will be able to enjoy the best part of choosing them as life companions. Raise your pet, give it your best and have fun playing together in the valley.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/205a3de5aedc57a4835e4798f90fbb52b9d58aab.gif[/img]
Developing version, you should see a different one when comes online.

[*]	Battle system adjustment (1st part)
In our first battle system adjustment we adjusted the attack range for both normal attack and battle spells. Plus, you should feel it more natural as they match the special effect we designed. We also introduce new sound effects in the developing version.

[*]	Raising bees and domestic silkmoths
We’re already working on these systems with new crop flowers and new recipes for honey!

[*]	New feature for creating and dyeing clothes
Silkmoths will unlock this system to create new cloth and change the way you currently dress. Plus, you’ll be able to modify its color!

[*]	A new adventure awaits!
After hearing about how impressive Jiufeng State is for so long time, why not start a new journey and find out what other mysteries it holds? You will visit some other iconic places of this large area, like the one you can see in the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/c9bbd68df74b09ce007ad3d92567b258fa7c0173.gif[/img]

[/olist]


[h2]WHEN ARE THEY COMING?[/h2]

Designing and implementing all these changes is not an easy task. Some of them require more time than others, so they will not all be ready for the next major update. Please stay tuned, we will keep you updated on everything!

We're committed to making as many tests as possible to avoid provoking new major bugs that affect your experience, but please bear in mind it could take a long time due to the limited test environment we have because of our long-distance work-from-home period.

We know you can’t wait to play our latest build, so we made the decision of splitting our game into two different branches:
[list]
[*] The Alpha branch, a private space where we will be testing new features. It's quite unstable and you'll surely find a ton of bugs, but also will allow you to learn about our progress before anyone else.
[*] The Default branch, the one you’re playing right now.
[/list]
We will push all our updates to the Default branch after a test period in the Alpha branch.

We'll be opening the Alpha branch in a few days and share the password you need to unlock it. But before you play, here's a little warning:

[u][b]❗❗❗We strongly recommend Alpha branch players backup the save locally, and start from the beginning. Using the default branch save might damage your save permanently. [/b][/u]

[h2]THE ROAD SO FAR[/h2]

The good news is, that most of our May items have been developed so far, and we even push the facial expression for June in our May update! However, with the limited UI human resources we get, the optimization for the map would be postponed to a later date. Concerning the Pet system, we need more time for developing and testing as the one our team is designing turns out to be more complex than planned.

[h2]WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE IN JUNE[/h2]
We’re glad to announce that a new fellow member will come to the valley! Song Yantong will introduce new gameplay designs and adventures for you to experience soon. We expect to include this character in the Alpha version in early-to-mid June, and then push her to the Default branch after major bugs are fixed.

We even have more changes in mind in June. Our list includes:
[olist]
[*]	UX improvement
You mentioned that some aspects of the game make you feel tired instead of relaxed. We’ve listened to your feedback and discussed what kind of changes we should make to fix this problem. We will be able to give you more information on how we will address these changes very soon.

[*]	Main quest update
Brother Xie gradually learns about the current situation after his awakening. With the new sect recently built and so many people joining it, what will he do next? Will he join your efforts to rebuild what's lost, or does he plan to discover the truth behind the tragedy? You will find out in this new chapter of the story.

[*]	New personal stories for some sect members
You would discover the story behind Song Yantong before you unlock the Bee Raising and Domestic Silkmoth Raising. This June, we would also start developing the story behind Mu Xia and Li Mengqing! 

[*]	New building: Sect Kitchen
The Sect kitchen will be unlocked after Mu Xia joins the sect. There will be more gameplay designs dedicated to this part of the game, we would introduce them gradually in future updates!

[*]	New trade routes: Fanhua Valley
Discover the story of this wonderful place and unlock its furniture and products.

[*]	New sect building: Sect Training Center
Brother Xie knows a lot of spells, it’s time to learn from him!
[/olist]


What we also included in our plan:
[olist]
[*]	More interactivity with your sect members
[*]	Grade of Foundation
[*]	Crops system Update
[*]	Events and Festival
[/olist]

Thank you to all members of our community for your continued support, please understand we would adjust our plan when talented ideas come out or we find something we need to do right now. Please refer to the latest announcement.

Thanks for playing and hope you enjoy your cultivation life!

notes.title: Immortal Life’s May-June Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/f59b0fbc314e4558acda6c2dce15701dbc3b81ab.jpg[/img]

Hi, brothers and sisters! 

We are super excited about your warm welcome and support during the Early Access release of Immortal Life. As you are well aware, our journey has just begun as the game entered last Thursday its Early Access stage. There’s a long and exciting road ahead of us, and we already planned several content updates and new features that will be added before the full release date. 

Our team got over 130 feedback and 95 bug reports during these first 55 hours. Over 70 bugs have already been fixed and we also implemented into the current game build 5 changes based on your most relevant suggestions. In essence, your comments will always have an impact on the game! 

Here and today, we’d like to discuss the problems our gamers are concerned about and share some thoughts we have about what Immortal Life should become in the future. 

So here we go! 

[h3]1. Battle system [/h3]

We’re not meant to become an action game, but the whole team thinks that you deserve a better designed and more complete battle system, to make your adventures in the caves much more satisfying. 

We will redesign part of it in the future, but please understand this battle system might take more than one update to be complete because we plan to work on it for a long time. If you have any feedback or suggestion about how it should be, we’re always willing to listen to your voice. 

[h3]2. What about the cultivation content? [/h3]

We know that only using the watering gourd and attending to lessons at the Guiyun sect headquarters is far away from the experience you expected to live in Immortal Life. For that reason, the world of cultivation will be the main subject of the new content update coming up in the following weeks. Stay tuned to learn more about this surprise! 

[h3]3. Why I am the only character working on everything?! [/h3]

We’re terribly sorry for letting some of our gamers feel this. We are about to make the Guiyun Sect a place more homely place with the help of your caring brothers and sisters: they will start texting you at random moments of the day to know what you’re up to. Also, we would also introduce a new game design dedicated to the Guiyun Sect, and this would just be the beginning!  

Our goal is to make a game that allows you to have an enjoyable and relaxing time in your immortal life, so please keep supporting the project as we walk toward our goal. 

[h3]4. This game is too complex for me! [/h3]

We already include 2 new actions that make your life much easier, which are allowing you to use left-clicking to plant seeds, harvest, etc., and the long-pressing the button E to cut down the trees or mining. 

But this is just the beginning. In a future update, we’d include new actions with more cultivation feeling in it. In fact, we already heard some fascinating feedback from our community that really draws our attention. We would love to implement them, so please stay patient with us until we can complete them. You should see some new action in the May Update. 

[h3]5. My warehouse is too small [/h3]
Yes, we know you all need more slots to keep your crops. With the new update coming today or tomorrow, you won’t need to worry anymore! It’s going to extend the space of your warehouse. And more storage methods, Items, and buildings are coming to you in the next 1-3 weeks! 

 
[h3]6. The main story is too short, will you add new content? [/h3]

After you pass the first 25 – 30 hours, you might feel there’re not many things to do.  
But don’t worry about it, because in our upcoming major update in May you will enjoy more new missions related to the main quest, more content about your wonderful new brothers and sisters, attractive collections, and even a special event! 

[h2]Roadmap for May and June[/h2]

For more information, here’s a visual scheme of our Roadmap for May and June: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/00d454fb217d2787b7f9311af8a3dc307adf6953.jpg[/img]

Are there any new features that you would like to see implemented in Immortal Life during the following weeks? Both YiFang Studio and 2P Games would love to hear your feedback, so don’t hesitate to drop us a line in the comments or share your thoughts via Discord. 

 
Best regards, 
YiFang Studios and 2P Games

This one is related to our first bug report, a short list we've been preparing in the last hours based on the early feedback we received.

Without further ado, these are the most important problems we have detected so far. Both of them are our highest priority right now, and we’ll push an update to fix them as soon as possible:
[list]
[*] The game may crash in some computers due to optimization issues.
[*] The main mission to rebuild the Main Hall may not be activated, which makes you can’t interact with You Jinghe [NPC].
[/list]

But there are other minor bugs you should know too:
[list]
[*] You might see the tools you’re using in wrong places like. e.g., above your head or under your feet.
[*] Right-clicking at the same time you press the Space bar might cause the game to crash.
[*] After changing the display mode to Windows Mode, the game would change to full screen under some circumstances.
[*] You might stuck in the air after jumping inside a room.
[*] The game might crash when you jump at the entrance of Sunset Forest.
[*] A mission can’t be finished.
[*] Players can’t go out of the pharmacy due to a small exit.
[/list]

Also, here’s a compendium of the most relevant suggestions for new features. We’ll add them all in our next updates!
[list]
[*] New character designs with different facial expressions and gestures.
[*] Key binding.
[*] Improvements in the battle experience.
[*] An option to disable the screen shake when you’re collecting wood or bamboo with the axe.
[*] 3D model redesign for some buildings.
[/list]

Thank you all for your help and support in this special day, we couldn’t have done it without you. If you have any new questions, complaints or suggestions for us, feel free to leave them in the comments section or reach us via Discord. We’ll be happy to assist you! 

Best regards, 
YiFang Studios and 2P Games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/a6771648805e9e887e7874beca434a8508822cbe.png[/img]

For those who’re not familiar with the game, Immortal Life is a [b]single-player management game[/b] where you take the role of a farmer aiming to deep-dive into the mysteries of soul cultivation. Since the HQ of the cult you aimed to join was destroyed by a natural disaster, you flee into a small village at the foot of the mountain with your new brothers and sisters to rebuild it. There you’ll take care of the crops and do what is needed to bring back the organisation to its glory days.

Work hard to achieve this ambitious goal, but don’t forget about the best part of starting a new life: strengthen your bonds with the community of the valley and explore the valley to unveil its mysteries. There’s a lot to do in this gorgeous place!

The [b]demo[/b], fully available in English, will give you access to the [b]early game[/b] and allow you to test the basic mechanics of Immortal Life until the moment you complete the quest of restoring the main building of the sect. It will be a delightful experience for those who had a great time farming, crafting, trading, and making new friends in Stardew Valley or Animal Crossing: New Horizons. Also, don’t hesitate to give it a try if you ever enjoyed Taoist fantasy stories, such as The Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation and Soul Land, or any others where spirituality and elemental magic take the centre stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36287417/c94748d3e6817e40b836aebf21f6cee5407a4692.png[/img]
